rules: discovery flags are unauthenticated hints and cannot prohibit a pinned TLS enrollment attempt
only a pinned TLS ERR_ENROLLMENT_REVOKED permits one fresh Windows identity generation and another explicit Android approval
disabled identities are retained; enable restores the same identity and address after canceled old flows drain
presence v2 server events are protected by WireGuard and bound to the current stream ticket; v1 client disconnect remains supported
Android blocks data flows before notifying disabled or revoked clients; a bounded control acknowledgement precedes key removal
server stop notifies current peers before WireGuard teardown; clients expire independent control and forwarded-response evidence within 35 seconds
an established tunnel or live control stream alone does not establish forwarding; recent forwarded replies survive a control-only outage
Windows keeps existing routes and WFP filters when hold-on-loss is enabled; otherwise helper shutdown closes the tunnel
While Windows waits for the next app command, its helper can independently report forwarding recovery and server Stop over the same local pipe
Windows presents a held server-unavailable session as paused while retaining its distinct unavailability reason; this does not establish forwarding or change recovery policy
revoked credentials never reactivate; a fresh identity and approval are required
three authorized records include offline and disabled clients; only explicit revocation releases a drained lease

windowsTestPackage.firewallChanges: none; inspect existing exact-path/profile rules read-only
